moment: Turning your digital identity into a physical statement.
title: Luxury Instagram Breakout
quote: Your photo. Now it breaks the frame.
context: A premium visual transformation that turns an ordinary portrait into a high-end luxury advertising campaign. The subject appears to physically break through a three-dimensional Instagram post card, creating the illusion that their digital identity has become tangible.
description: Create an ultra-premium, glossy, dark luxury Instagram post mockup in which the person from the uploaded photo dramatically breaks through a realistic physical Instagram card. The result combines luxury editorial photography, premium product design, and photorealistic 3D compositing.
condition: Best created using a clear, high-resolution portrait where the subject's face is unobstructed and identity can be accurately preserved.

recipe.concept: A real person physically breaking through a premium, dark Instagram post card.
recipe.composition: Center the subject within a thick, slightly curved Instagram card. Create a convincing torn opening around the emerging body, with one arm extending beyond the card toward the viewer while the other remains partially inside the frame.

subject.pose: Confident, dynamic, anatomically realistic, with one arm extending naturally toward the viewer through the torn opening.
subject.anatomy: Correct human anatomy, natural proportions, realistic hands and fingers, physically believable interaction with the card.

card.shape: Slightly curved, thick, substantial, rounded corners
tear: Believable paper deformation around the subject

instagramInterface.hierarchy: Clean spacing and realistic social-media UI proportions

text.typography: Crisp, professionally aligned, clean and highly legible

environment.atmosphere: Subtle cinematic smoke around the card and subject without obscuring the face or interface

commands: Preserve the uploaded person's identity exactly and naturally.
Replace any original character completely with the person from the uploaded photograph.
Make the Instagram card feel like a real physical luxury object.
Make the torn paper physically believable around the emerging body.
Extend one arm naturally toward the viewer with convincing depth and perspective.
Keep the other arm partially inside the Instagram frame.
Separate the black clothing, black card, and black background using controlled lighting.
Keep the face unobstructed and recognizable.
Make all typography crisp, correctly spelled, and professionally aligned.
Maintain realistic anatomy, hands, fingers, proportions, and perspective.
Make the final image feel tactile, expensive, cinematic, and professionally art-directed.
